description: This Java class, FeedParser, parses Atom XML feeds from an InputStream and extracts entries containing id, title, link, and published timestamp. It is part of a sync adapter network package, responsible for handling and parsing feed data from web sources.

classes.name: FeedParser
classes.description: A class that parses Atom XML feeds into a list of Entry objects.

classes.name: FeedParser.Entry
classes.description: Represents a single feed entry with id, title, link, and published timestamp.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses an InputStream representing an Atom feed and returns a list of Entry objects.

methods.name: readFeed
methods.description: Reads the feed element, extracting individual entries.

methods.name: readEntry
methods.description: Reads individual entry elements, extracting id, title, link, and published date.

methods.name: readTag
methods.description: Reads specific tags such as id, title, published, or link from the XML.

methods.name: readBasicTag
methods.description: Reads the body text of a simple, non-nested XML tag.

methods.name: readAlternateLink
methods.description: Processes <link> tags to extract href attribute where rel='alternate'.

methods.name: readText
methods.description: Extracts text content from the current tag.

methods.name: skip
methods.description: Skips over XML tags that are not of interest, handling nested tags properly.
